title: Settings
llmSubscriptionNotice: ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Gemini Advanced, and Cursor subscriptions do not grant API access. Configure an API key or use a local runner (Ollama, LM Studio).
freeTierOnRamps: Free and low-cost API on-ramps: Groq (free tier), Google AI Studio (free tier), OpenRouter (:free).

classifyCheapDesc: Classifies acronyms, numerals, and toponyms. Fast model recommended.
dialogueHardDesc: Resolves ambiguous speaker turns and speaker genders.
pronounceDesc: Generates approximate Polish phonetic respellings for foreign tokens.
